avoidWhen.text: Avoid for single-record detail forms that do not render a collection.

customize.text: Tailor the empty message and optional call to action to what will appear in the collection.

keep.text: Populated collections expose an accessible listbox or list with named items.
An empty collection shows a plain-text empty message and is never announced as an error alert.
A failed collection read announces the error with role alert and explains how to recover.
Keep empty-result copy distinct from read-failure copy so people can tell nothing matched from a broken fetch.

empty.text: Mount an empty collection (such as Loam's ListEmpty) showing a plain empty message with no alert role.

failed.text: Mount a failed collection read (such as Loam's ListFailed) with role alert carrying the failure message and recovery suggestion.

populated.text: Mount a populated collection (such as Loam's loam-list) labeled "Greetings" with at least one selectable item.

summary: Distinguish populated, empty, loading, and failed collection states clearly so an empty list never looks like an error.

useWhen.text: Use for any screen region backed by a list or search command that can be loading, populated, empty, or failed.
